title: Sum of Even Numbers
statement: A canteen keeps a list of token numbers issued during the day. The manager wants the total of all token numbers that are even. Given the list, print the sum of its even values.
input_format: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.
output_format: Print one integer: the sum of the even values (0 if there are none).
constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 100000; each value is between -1000000000 and 1000000000.

examples.explanation: 2 and 4 are even, so the sum is 6.

hints: A number is even when the remainder after dividing by 2 is zero. Negative numbers can be even too.
Keep a running total and add each value only when it is even.
The total can be larger than a 32-bit integer can hold; use a 64-bit type where your language needs one.
